Service restored

The requested report is available. Earlier today, a deployment temporarily showed a security verification screen to some visitors. The incident has been resolved, ordinary page delivery has resumed, and no action is required from readers.

During recovery, engineers corrected a cache rule and confirmed that article responses now contain the intended source content. Monitoring has remained healthy since the change. This notice records the resolution so affected readers understand why access briefly changed.

The rest of this page contains the normal report. Teams completed the release, validated the data, and published the updated results. Readers can use the navigation links, download the report, or continue through the analysis without completing any verification step.
